svg.title: MINER vs WARP — in-game ping performance
svg.desc: A five-minute League of Legends comparison on November 5, 2026. Average: WARP 143.90 milliseconds, MINER 24.28 milliseconds. Median: WARP 144, MINER 24. 95th percentile: WARP 151, MINER 31. MINER's average is 83.1 percent lower. WARP had 281 valid OCR readings from 300 frames, MINER 297 from 300. A preliminary on-screen reading comparison, not server RTT or packet loss.

g.aria-label: League of Legends / five minutes per mode / lower is better
300 samples per mode · WARP: 281 valid (93.7%) · MINER: 297 valid (99.0%)
Preliminary in-game HUD OCR samples; not direct server RTT or packet-loss data.
